title: Headless TTW Among the Stars (DLC05MZ2): from the cryo tubes' thaw through Sally's crawl and the mothership's three generators to the Experimental Lab (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10) and Not of This World done (DLC05MZ1 200: its chain, which ends with Sally by the cryo lab), aboard the mothership in the engine core by the cryo tubes, where that chain ends. Sally is placed beside the player there too, where the headless MoveTo puts her [observed: pilot rerun log, (-1140, -12428, 250) in DLC05EngineCore]; without her the MoveTo below waited 60 s for an AI walk that never came. DLC05MZ1's last stage starts DLC05MZ2 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone.
The cryo tubes' stasis controls (DLC05StasisControlsScript [observed]): Paulson and Elliott Tercorien thawed (MZ2Unfrozen 1).
Sally (with the player since the cells) speaks of the astronaut who did not live through the thaw (SallyCrawl 1).
Stand-in for Sally's crawl through the duct to open the way (her package DLC05EngineCoreSallyCrawl2, the AI's): its end opens the force field and shows the three generators' objectives [observed].

Stand-in for each generator: in each area (the cryo lab, the hangar, robotics, with their own support quests DLC05CryoQ, DLC05HQ and DLC05Asm, whose fights and talks are left out) the player opens the generator with its switches (ActivatedSwitches) so its core shows and overheats, and shoots the core until it breaks. Headless the generator's opening animation does not play (the core waits on IsAnimPlaying) [observed: the core stays hidden], so the core's own Destroyed is set to 2 as its breaking leaves it; its script then blows the generator and counts it (DLC05CryoQ.CryoGenDestroyed, DLC05HQ 255, DLC05Asm 255: MZ2Generator) [observed: DLC05GeneratorCoreSCRIPT].
Travel stand-in: to the cryo lab's generator (DLC05CryoGeneratorREF).

actions.label: generators down after the cryo lab

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to the hangar's generator (DLC05HangarGeneratorRef).
Travel stand-in: back to the engine core (all three down: the followers released), then into the Experimental Lab (DLC05ExLab01): the quest's script sets 200 [observed: DLC05MZ2QuestScript].
